title: LegalArchetypeSchema
description: Defines the structural format and signature layout for legal governance addenda (BAA, DPA, Privacy Policy) committed to the Archivum Ledger.

archetypeId.description: Unique identifier for the legal archetype (e.g., LEG-BAA-2026-v1).

name.description: Descriptive name of the legal addendum.

version.description: Semantic version of the legal template.

contentHash.description: Cryptographic SHA-256 hash of the raw legal agreement document.

effectiveDate.description: ISO 8601 timestamp representing the effective date of the agreement.

expirationDate.description: Optional ISO 8601 timestamp for the agreement expiration.

identity.description: The informational identity of the signatory.

role.description: The compliance role of the signatory in the governance framework.

publicKey.description: Base64-encoded Ed25519 public key of the signatory.

signature.description: Base64-encoded Ed25519 signature over the contentHash.

complianceFramework.description: The standard framework that this agreement satisfies.

auditStatus.description: The current status of the legal review.

reviewer.description: The identity or key of the compliance officer who approved the schema.
